newsitem.title: FINLAND: AAMULEHTI SELLS ALDATA, TO BOOK GAIN.
newsitem.headline: AAMULEHTI SELLS ALDATA, TO BOOK GAIN.

text.p: Finnish media house Aamulehti-yhtuma Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it had sold its information technology unit Aldata to a new company.

It said it would own 27 percent of the company to be formed and book an "over 60 million markka gain" from the arrangement. The other owners of the new company were Aldata's management and Finnish venture funds CapMan Capital Managment Oy and SITRA. .
"The deal will create a significant new information technology company in Finland," Aamulehti said.
The new company is expected to have net sales of about 180 million markka in 1997, it said.
Aamulehti said the first stage of the deal had included the acquisition of Modern Soft Oy-- a group that specializes in system deliveries for the retailing of consumer dailies and special products.
